sources: Bhagavata Purana, Canto 4, chapter 8 (Narada's mantra, the months of austerity, the earth leaning), chapter 9 (Vishnu appears, the conch, boon, verse 4.9.35 'broken grains'), chapter 12 (36,000 years, Dhruvaloka). Vishnu Purana 1.12 differs: Dhruva asks only for the knowledge to praise Vishnu. The line 'searching for glass, I found a jewel' is NOT in the Bhagavata (it is from Hari-bhakti-sudhodaya), so it is not used.

en.title: What a Five-Year-Old Did to the Gods | Dhruva Part 2 of 2
en.description:
What can a five-year-old do that makes the gods afraid?

Dhruva ate less every month, stood on one foot, and stopped breathing. The whole world felt it, and the gods ran to Vishnu.

Retold from the Bhagavata Purana, Canto 4, chapters 8-9 and 12. The Vishnu Purana tells this story with differences.

Part 1: The Boy Who Refused to Accept It.
